html:
Pelé, born Edson Arantes do Nascimento, was a Brazilian footballer and one of the greatest players of all time. He is the only player to win three World Cups.

He grew up poor in the state of São Paulo and joined Santos at fifteen. At seventeen he scored twice in the final of the 1958 World Cup in Sweden. He won again in 1962 and, with one of the finest teams ever, at the 1970 World Cup in Mexico, the first shown in colour around the world.

  • He scored over a thousand goals in his career, counting friendlies.
  • Brazil's government declared him a national treasure to keep him from moving to a European club.
  • In 1975 he joined the New York Cosmos and helped make football known in the United States.
  • From 1995 to 1998 he served as Brazil's minister of sport.

The World Cup had begun in 1930 as a small South American event; Pelé made it a world stage and made Brazilian football, with its flair and skill, famous everywhere. He died in 2022.
sum: Pelé, born Edson Arantes do Nascimento, was a Brazilian footballer and one of the greatest players of all time. He is the only player to win three World Cups.
